description: Land Acquisition - Two amendments of Rathnapura and Malimbada D/S Division and two notices in Wegalle, Bulathkohupitiya and Ihala Karagahamuna, D/S  Division, Mahara D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains multiple notices and amendments related to the acquisition of specific land parcels for public purposes (resettlement of landslide victims, road construction), including descriptions of land, extents, claimants, and compensation procedures. The content falls squarely within the "Land and property-related matters" category, specifically land acquisitions, which defines Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
